purpose: Sanitized historical handover index; not a raw response, new demonstration, or proof of clearance/delivery.
redaction: Only source filenames, source digests, whitelisted numeric HTTP statuses and fixed outcome labels are retained. Original actor/case/document identifiers, source facts, quotations, session material, timestamps and request bodies are omitted.

sources.interpretation: Historical recorded fields only; nested repeated fields may describe the same request. No fresh run, actor identity, source quotation or authority is inferred.
